name: John Day River (Clarno–Cottonwood)
gaugeName: John Day River at Service Creek
blurb: Remote multi-day desert-canyon trips between Clarno and Cottonwood Bridge, with a shorter trip option at Thirtymile. Plan around river level, road access and year-round boating permits.

sections.notes: A Recreation.gov boating permit is required year-round between Service Creek and Tumwater Falls. Clarno Rapid near the start is the hardest drop — scout it. The gauge is at Service Creek, just upstream.

guideTimes.conditions: BLM’s common itinerary for the whole Clarno–Cottonwood trip; flow, camps, wind and stops change travel time.

notices.title: Year-round river permit
notices.text: A Recreation.gov permit is required for day and overnight trips from Service Creek to Tumwater Falls. Check current BLM closures and river conditions before departure.
notices.sourceName: BLM John Day Wild and Scenic River

distanceEvidence.sourceName: BLM John Day River Launches and Camping Information
distanceEvidence.note: Approximate distance from the BLM named-access river-mile table. Clarno is mile 109.2, Thirtymile 84, and Cottonwood / J.S. Burres 39.6. Rounded whole-trip descriptions in other guides differ slightly; these sections consistently use this one table.

sections.notes: Arrange the long road shuttle before launch. This upper trip includes Clarno Rapid; scout it and assess whether a portage is necessary. Thirtymile is a primitive ramp; carrying boats to the water may be necessary.

notices.title: Year-round river permit
notices.text: A Recreation.gov permit is required for day and overnight trips from Service Creek to Tumwater Falls. Check current BLM closures and river conditions before departure.

notices.title: Thirtymile seasonal road access
notices.text: Use Armstrong Road and the designated riverside parking area. BLM closes vehicle access December 15–March 31; wet weather can make the road impassable. High clearance and suitable tires are recommended, with 4WD for trailers.
notices.sourceName: BLM Thirtymile visitor information, updated September 2025
